messages:
jess: opened a tiny PR to add a quick troubleshooting playbook for sporadic 429s/timeouts + a curl header-capture example. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/478

omar: can we list the exact headers to capture in every support ticket? makes triage way faster.

rachel: yes — recommend X-Request-Id, X-RatePool, X-Model-Variant, X-Retry-After, and client IP if present. also add a one-line decision tree: fallback vs backoff vs escalate to Dedicated.

ty: will add two micro-snippets: (1) curl showing response headers, (2) tiny JS retry+trim example. keep them minimal so they fit the quickstart page.

jess: added curl sample: `curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" -d '{"prompt":"..."}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate |& tee /tmp/resp && rg "X-Request-Id|X-RatePool|X-Model-Variant|X-Retry-After" /tmp/resp`

omar: add ticket template line so support gets headers + sample payload + approximate QPS + whether customer is on Dedicated. also warn about aggressive client retries.

rachel: tiny wording nit: say "trim oldest tokens first" for context-limit retries. helps UX.

jess: added nitfix and a one-paragraph escalation note for Dedicated (who to ping and what infra needs). ready to merge after a quick lint.

docs-bot: lint OK. formatting adjusted for code fences. :white_check_mark:
